scope.purpose: Read-only Kaggle status for the already-dispatched R2 profile and TPU V8 kernel

resource_snapshot.direct_child_snapshot_relation: Exact child current/max values were read immediately after the status command returned; a separate timestamp was not captured.

cause: The operator used the parent current reading but failed to recalculate all active direct-child unused memory limits before starting the bounded status scope.
impact: A short read-only poll ran while root's LSQ fit and two native evaluations were active. The bound estimated from the parent pre-scope current, immediate post-scope child unused limits, and the scope cap exceeded the 17 GB target but remained below the 20 GB hard cgroup limit. It is an incident estimate, not a simultaneous sample. No fit was launched or killed, no provider mutation occurred, and no OOM or limit change was observed.
containment: No more status support scopes until a fresh parent-current plus all active direct-child unused-reservation calculation, including the proposed scope, is at or below 17000000000 bytes. Preserve healthy workers and existing provider attempts.
